name: @titanforge/app
description: The actual IDE page: a Vite browser app wiring together the virtual filesystem, TypeScript language service, Monaco bridge, shell, and DAP toy-language debugger into a working file tree + editor + terminal + debug panel. Terminal UI is a small hand-built scrollback+input element rather than xterm.js, to keep this package's only new runtime dependency to monaco-editor itself (see src/terminalPane.ts for the reasoning).
